expected.tagline: Ultimate Chicken Horse is a party platformer game where you build the level as you play, placing traps and hazards to screw your friends over, but trying not to screw yourself.
expected.description:
Wishlist Ultimate Sheep Raccoon!Our upcoming bike-racing party game, releasing Winter 2025!

About the GameEver wish you were a wall-jumping, arrow-dodging, trap-setting horse, besting your animal pals in a race through a peril-laden obstacle course that you all built together?

Wish Granted!

Ultimate Chicken Horse is a party platformer where you and your friends build the level as you play, placing deadly traps before trying to reach the end of the level. If you can make it but your friends can't, you score points! Play online or locally with your animal buddies and experiment with a wide variety of platforms in all sorts of strange locations to find new ways to mess with your friends.Key FeaturesOnline, cross-platform, and local play for up to 4 players
Unique game flow, from strategic block placement to twitch control platforming
21 levels with different features 
Build and share custom levels
Compete for global best times on Challenge levels across all platforms
Huge library of blocks to create an infinite variety of levels
Customizable rule sets and game modes
Shared controller mode to play multiplayer with one controller or keyboard
Play as a chicken, horse, sheep, raccoon and other wonderful animals
Fun, cartoony art style
Sweet funky soundtrack Please note: this is primarily a multiplayer game. Challenge levels can be created and played alone, but unlocking characters and levels requires playing one of the main game modes (like Party Mode) which are only multiplayer.

installSteps.text: Alternatively, download Ultimate Chicken Horse directly from the official site at http://www.ultimatechickenhorse.com. Always download from the official source — third-party mirrors of free games are a common malware vector.
Ultimate Chicken Horse is also on Steam and is free there. Open the store page and press Play Game to add it to your library.

Run the downloaded installer and follow the prompts. If Windows SmartScreen warns about an unrecognised publisher, that is normal for open-source projects without a paid code-signing certificate — choose More info, then Run anyway.
Open the downloaded .dmg and drag the app into Applications. On first launch macOS may refuse to open it as unidentified — right-click the app and choose Open to approve it once.
Check your distribution's package manager first, which is usually the easiest route. Otherwise download the AppImage from the official site, mark it executable and run it.
Launch the game and look at the settings menu before your first session — resolution and control defaults are worth checking. Ultimate Chicken Horse needs roughly 2.0 GB of free disk space.

set.tagline: Build the obstacle course together. Survive the part your friends built for you.
set.description: Ultimate Chicken Horse is a four-player party platformer where each round starts with everyone adding platforms and traps to the same course. Reach the goal when your friends cannot to score. Play locally or online across Windows, macOS, and Linux, with controller and shared-controller options.

min.gpuText: Windows: Intel HD 4000, GeForce 200 or Radeon HD 4000 class; macOS/Linux: 512 MB VRAM
min.notes: Broadband internet is required for online play. Steam's Windows client now requires Windows 10 or later.

recommended.notes: Broadband internet is required for online play.

qualityBar.verdict: The funniest trap is the one you thought you could clear and placed yourself.

set.longDescription:
Ultimate Chicken Horse makes you the architect of your own downfall. At the start of a round, everyone chooses a piece for the same little platforming course. You might add a generous bridge, a saw blade in a mean spot, or an arrow trap that seems perfectly aimed at someone else. Then the building stops and all four animals try to reach the goal. If you make it and your friends do not, you score. If the course becomes impossible for everyone, your clever construction has achieved absolutely nothing.

That loop is the whole joke, and it stays funny because the level belongs to the group. A safe route you used last round may acquire a new hazard. A shortcut you built for yourself can help the other three players. You have to think like a designer and then immediately live with the result as a player. It is a small, sharp idea that produces better stories than a stack of unrelated minigames. Everyone remembers who placed the spinning saw and who ran into it first. Sometimes those are the same person.

The platforming asks for real timing. Wall jumps, moving hazards, and narrow landings make a successful run satisfying even before the scoreboard appears. Over several rounds the course grows from a few recognizable obstacles into a history of grudges. Rules can be customized, and the included level editor lets you build and share a course without waiting for the usual round-by-round construction. Challenge levels can be played alone, but the main mode and its unlocks are built around multiplayer. This is a game to bring to people, not a solo campaign to quietly finish.

Up to four players can play locally or online, and the developer lists cross-platform multiplayer. A shared controller mode even lets people trade one pad or keyboard, though separate controllers are the easier setup for a long session. The store also lists online and shared-screen co-op options, but the familiar Party Mode is competitive: you are trying to finish when your friends cannot. There is no dedicated server to provision and no LAN tunnel required to make its built-in online play work.

Ultimate Chicken Horse is a paid game on Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux. PlayBound should send you to the store to acquire it, then help you locate the installed copy; it should never promise a free download. The developer lists 2 GB of available storage and broadband for online play. We picked it for the way it turns player creativity into the source of both the difficulty and the comedy. The course is never just an obstacle. It is an argument your friends are still editing while you run it.
set.whyWePickedIt: We picked Ultimate Chicken Horse because building the course together makes every round personal. The traps are simple; seeing how friends use and misuse them is the entertainment. Local and online play make it a strong game-night pick, with no server hosting claim needed.
set.thatOneThing: You can place the saw blade, forget you placed it, and lose to your own excellent level design.

installSteps.text: Buy Ultimate Chicken Horse on its official Steam page and add it to your library. This is a paid game, even when Steam is running a temporary discount.
Install the Windows build through Steam. Open it from your Steam library after the download finishes.
Install the macOS build through Steam, then launch it from your library. Check Steam's current macOS client requirements before buying.
Install the Linux build through Steam, then launch it from your library. The developer lists SteamOS, Ubuntu or a comparable Linux distribution.

firstPlaySteps.text: Connect each local controller before opening Party Mode. The game also offers a shared controller or keyboard option.
Play a simple course first so everyone can learn movement and building before changing the rules or loading custom levels.

multiplayerGamingSteps.text: For local play, connect up to four players and choose Party Mode from the game menu.
For online play, create a lobby in the game and invite friends through its built-in online system. No dedicated server or virtual LAN setup is needed.

bestFor: Groups who like competitive games that stay friendly
Players who enjoy making levels as much as beating them
Four-player local or online game nights
notFor: Anyone expecting a full solo campaign
Players who want a free-to-play game
